verification_steps: 1. Identify entity, as-of date, source authority and requested scenario (ownership, dilution, option pool or financing). 2. Reconcile security classes, shares, options, convertibles and reserved pool against current legal cap-table source; flag conflicts. 3. Calculate fully diluted ownership and post-money dilution under explicit price/conversion/pool assumptions. 4. Label issued vs granted vs reserved vs converted securities and present scenario sensitivities. 5. Return calculation workpaper for counsel/Principal/finance review; do not edit official cap table or advise legal rights.
Share totals and denominator consistent; scenarios cite assumptions; no legal interpretation.
Cite source refs and report uncertainty; no balancing plugs.
